```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center", dpi = 300)

# Load packages from the ENVT4461 spatial & reporting workflow
need <- c("sp", "sf", "maptiles", "prettymapr", "flextable", "officer")
for(pkg in need){
  if(!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE)){
    install.packages(pkg)
    library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)

}

set_flextable_defaults(font.family = "Arial", font.size = 9,
                       theme_fun = "theme_booktabs", padding = 2,
                       na_str = "-")
```

## 1. Data Cleaning & Spatial Projection

We import the WAMEX surface soil geochemistry dataset (`ss_assay_pivoted_2.csv`), standardize below-detection-limit (BDL) negative values (`-10`) to `NA`, and project WGS84 geographic coordinates (`EPSG:4326`) to UTM Zone 50S (`EPSG:32750`).

```{r data-cleaning}
# Read raw lines and fix WAMEX unescaped comma-quote formatting in sampleid
raw_lines <- readLines("ss_assay_pivoted.csv", warn = FALSE)
clean_lines <- gsub('"," ', ' - ', raw_lines, fixed = TRUE)
soil <- read.csv(text = clean_lines, stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                 check.names = FALSE, na.strings = c("NA", "NULL", ""))

# Standardize metal column names (mg/kg) and convert BDL values (<= 0) to NA
metal_cols <- c("Cu_PPM", "Ni_PPM", "Pb_PPM", "Zn_PPM")
clean_names <- c("Cu", "Ni", "Pb", "Zn")
for(i in seq_along(metal_cols)){
  vals <- as.numeric(soil[[metal_cols[i]]])
  vals[vals <= 0] <- NA
  soil[[clean_names[i]]] <- vals
}

# Convert coordinates to sf object and project to UTM Zone 50S (EPSG:32750)
soil$longitude <- as.numeric(soil$longitude)
soil$latitude <- as.numeric(soil$latitude)
soil_sf <- st_as_sf(soil, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) |>
  st_transform(crs = st_crs(32750))

# Extract projected Easting and Northing (m) for base R spatial plotting
coords_utm <- st_coordinates(soil_sf)
soil$Easting <- coords_utm[, 1]
soil$Northing <- coords_utm[, 2]
soil$company <- factor(soil$company)

# Helper functions reused from ENVT4461 workflow
summ_one <- function(df, vars){
  out <- data.frame(Variable = vars,
                    mean = NA, sd = NA, min = NA, median = NA, max = NA, n = NA, nNA = NA)
  for(i in seq_along(vars)){
    x <- df[[vars[i]]]
    nvalid <- length(na.omit(x))
    out$n[i] <- nvalid
    out$nNA[i] <- sum(is.na(x))
    if(nvalid > 0){
      out$mean[i] <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
      out$sd[i] <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
      out$min[i] <- min(x, na.rm = TRUE)
      out$median[i] <- median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
      out$max[i] <- max(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }
  out
}

format_ft <- function(df, caption, font_size = 9){
  flextable(df) |>
    bold(part = "header") |>
    fontsize(size = font_size, part = "all") |>
    align(align = "right", part = "body") |>
    align(j = 1, align = "left", part = "all") |>
    valign(valign = "center", part = "all") |>
    set_caption(caption = caption) |>
    autofit()
}
```

## 2. Ecological Guideline Comparison & Spatial Zone Testing

We compare surface soil metal concentrations against conservative Ecological Investigation Levels (EILs; NEPC Schedule B5a) and partition valid samples along the median UTM Northing into a northern **Mineralised Core Zone** and a southern **Peripheral Buffer Zone** to test spatial dispersion using Kruskal-Wallis tests.

```{r guideline-and-zone-test}
# 1. Define conservative NEPC Schedule B5a EILs (mg/kg)
metals <- c("Cu", "Ni", "Pb", "Zn")
eil_vals <- c(Cu = 22, Ni = 30, Pb = 480, Zn = 27)

# Overall summary and EIL exceedance table (reusing summ_one & format_ft)
metal_sum <- summ_one(soil, metals)
metal_sum$EIL <- eil_vals[metal_sum$Variable]
metal_sum$n_exceed <- mapply(function(v, eil) sum(soil[[v]] > eil, na.rm = TRUE),
                             metal_sum$Variable, metal_sum$EIL)
metal_sum$pct_exceed <- round(100 * metal_sum$n_exceed / metal_sum$n, 1)

eil_tab <- data.frame(
  Element = metal_sum$Variable,
  `EIL (mg/kg)` = metal_sum$EIL,
  `Median (mg/kg)` = round(metal_sum$median, 2),
  `Max (mg/kg)` = round(metal_sum$max, 2),
  `Valid n` = metal_sum$n,
  `Exceedances (> EIL)` = paste0(metal_sum$n_exceed, "/", metal_sum$n,
                                 " (", metal_sum$pct_exceed, "%)"),
  check.names = FALSE
)

format_ft(eil_tab, "Table 1. Summary statistics and EIL comparison for surface soil metals (mg/kg).")

# 2. Partition valid multi-metal samples into North (Core) vs South (Buffer)
valid_soil <- soil[rowSums(!is.na(soil[, metals])) > 0, ]
cutoff_north <- median(valid_soil$Northing, na.rm = TRUE)
valid_soil$Zone <- factor(ifelse(valid_soil$Northing >= cutoff_north,
                                 "Core (North)", "Buffer (South)"))

# Kruskal-Wallis test across spatial zones
zone_tab <- data.frame(
  Element = metals,
  `Core Median` = NA,
  `Buffer Median` = NA,
  `Kruskal-Wallis P` = NA,
  check.names = FALSE
)

for(i in seq_along(metals)){
  v <- metals[i]
  zone_tab$`Core Median`[i] <- round(median(valid_soil[valid_soil$Zone == "Core (North)", v], na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  zone_tab$`Buffer Median`[i] <- round(median(valid_soil[valid_soil$Zone == "Buffer (South)", v], na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  zone_tab$`Kruskal-Wallis P`[i] <- signif(kruskal.test(valid_soil[[v]] ~ valid_soil$Zone)$p.value, 3)
}

format_ft(zone_tab, "Table 2. Spatial comparison between Mineralised Core and Peripheral Buffer zones.")
```

## 3. Spatial Distribution of Soil Metals

To visualise spatial dispersion and localised hotspots, we overlay concentration-scaled sample bubbles onto high-resolution satellite imagery (`Esri.WorldImagery`, UTM Zone 50S). Samples exceeding site-specific EILs are highlighted with solid red circles.

```{r spatial-maps, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=7.2}
# 1. Define UTM Zone 50S map extent and fetch satellite basemap
map_extent <- st_as_sf(data.frame(x = c(493250, 494950),
                                  y = c(6805300, 6807100)),
                       coords = c("x", "y"), crs = st_crs(32750))
sat_tiles <- get_tiles(map_extent, provider = "Esri.WorldImagery", crop = TRUE, zoom = 15)
map_frame <- st_coordinates(map_extent)

# 2. Proportional bubble scaling function (reused from ENVT4461 workflow)
scale_cex <- function(x){
  out <- rep(0.70, length(x))
  ok <- !is.na(x)
  if(sum(ok) > 1){
    lo <- min(x[ok], na.rm = TRUE)
    hi <- as.numeric(quantile(x[ok], 0.95, na.rm = TRUE))
    if(hi > lo){
      xx <- pmin(x[ok], hi)
      out[ok] <- 0.65 + 1.55 * sqrt((xx - lo) / (hi - lo))
    }
  }
  out[!ok] <- NA
  out
}

# 3. Plotting function for each metal panel
plot_metal_map <- function(v){
  x <- valid_soil[[v]]
  ok <- !is.na(x)
  psize <- scale_cex(x)
  xy <- cbind(valid_soil$Easting, valid_soil$Northing)
  is_bad <- !is.na(x) & (x > eil_vals[v])

  plot(map_frame, type = "n", asp = 1, xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i",
       xlab = "", ylab = "", axes = FALSE)
  plot_tiles(sat_tiles, add = TRUE)

  points(xy[ok, ], pch = 21,
         bg = ifelse(is_bad[ok], "red", "white"),
         col = "grey15", cex = psize[ok], lwd = 0.8)

  title(main = paste0(v, " (EIL = ", eil_vals[v], " mg/kg)"), cex.main = 0.95)
  if(v == "Cu"){
    legend("bottomright", bg = "#ffffffdd", box.col = "white", cex = 0.68,
           legend = c("Below EIL", "Exceeds EIL", "Larger = higher"),
           pch = c(21, 21, 21), pt.bg = c("white", "red", "white"),
           col = "grey15", pt.cex = c(1.0, 1.0, 1.7), lwd = 0.8)
  }
  box()
}

# 4. Render 2x2 multi-panel map
par(mfrow = c(2, 2), mar = c(0.6, 0.6, 1.5, 0.4), oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
for(v in metals) plot_metal_map(v)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
